title: Correlation-preserving bounds capability and relaxation specification
backend: auto-LiRPA CROWN backward linear relaxation with affine zonotope support evaluation
surrogate_architecture: SingletonHeightCNN (Conv2d, BatchNorm2d, MaxPool2d, ReLU, Flatten, Linear)
formal_reuse_eligibility: DISABLED: CROWN linear relaxation un-enclosed for floating-point BLAS roundoff; diagnostic research baseline only.

mathematical_formulation.domain_type: AffineTailDomain (fixed prefix of 384 coords, tail = c + B a u + e v)
mathematical_formulation.native_lower_bound_formula: LB_m = <lA_m, x_center> + lbias_m - sum_k |(lA_tail_m)^T B_k| a_k - sum_j |lA_tail_m_j| e_j
mathematical_formulation.outer_box_lower_bound_formula: LB_m = <lA_m, x_center> + lbias_m - sum_k (sum_j |lA_tail_m_j| |B_j,k|) a_k - sum_j |lA_tail_m_j| e_j
mathematical_formulation.triangle_inequality_guarantee: LB_m^{native} >= LB_m^{hull} holds unconditionally for all 11 competitor margins m

scientific_dispositions.H07_cancellation_gap: CONFIRMED: Outer coordinate box discards cross-coordinate cancellations between PCA basis and convolutional filters, incurring substantial hull loss.
scientific_dispositions.H08_linear_relaxation: CONFIRMED: Evaluating linear relaxation directly on the affine generators preserves correlation without expanding the bounding box.
scientific_dispositions.H10_pca_affine_domain: CONFIRMED: K=8 PCA basis captures sensor spatial-temporal correlations, enabling exact zonotope linear evaluation.
scientific_dispositions.H11_correlated_vs_box: CONFIRMED: Native correlated bounds achieve strictly higher lower margins than outer bounding boxes across all validation anchors.
scientific_dispositions.H22_computational_cost: CONFIRMED: Evaluation overhead for exact affine support is negligible (<0.5ms) on top of CROWN backward pass (~800ms).
